assertions.name: S4-A1-digest-presence-not-equal-fetchability
assertions.note: a recorded version/digest being present must not be treated as the artifact being fetchable | expected: the PASS depends on resolving the recorded version's artifact (verifier can receive/resolve one) | observed: recorded subject.version present=True; its artifact in available_artifacts=False; verify(recorded)=PASS reached with no resolution channel (params=['envelopes', 'verifier']) => presence accepted as fetchable

assertions.name: S4-A2-mismatch-is-FAIL
assertions.note: a decision recorded under a version that mismatches the required one must verify as FAIL | expected: the compatibility rule can enter the verifier and a mismatched recorded version yields FAIL | observed: compatibility rule {'required_version': 'policy-v2'} has no channel (resolution params=none); verify(recorded policy-v1)=PASS == verify(policy-v2)=PASS; verdict invariant to recorded version=True

assertions.name: S4-A4-current-version-not-silently-substituted
assertions.note: the recorded version must not be silently replaced by the current one | expected: the recorded version is read back verbatim and substituting it is detected | observed: read_back='policy-v1'; after substituting to 'policy-CURRENT-substituted': valid=False, broken_at=0

assertions.name: S4-A3-unavailable-required-artifact-is-NOT_MEASURED
assertions.note: when a required policy/state artifact is unavailable, the verdict must be NOT_MEASURED, not PASS | expected: an unavailable required artifact produces a NOT_MEASURED attributable to it | observed: no artifact channel exists (resolution params=none), so the required-artifact premise cannot enter; verify(recorded)=PASS (valid=True) => no unavailable artifact can cause a NOT_MEASURED

limitations: in-process surface: drives verify_chain directly, not a running MCP host round-trip

A3's 'required artifact unavailable' is a premise of the scenario, not a fetch this fixture attempts — the point is that verify_chain never requires or resolves such an artifact, so no verdict can be attributed to its absence; a host that added artifact resolution could exercise the fetch itself
A1/A2/A3 measure the ABSENCE of a version-compatibility evaluator, not a defect within one; A4 confirms the recorded version is hash-bound and tamper-evident
signature verification uses the fixture's own HMAC signer wrapped as the Verifier; the Ed25519 path and the shipped no-verifier default (see S5) are out of scope here
the installed distribution's binding to IMPL_COMMIT is not attested by the artifact itself
